result.brief: 提出 Oneira，用编码智能体维护可扩展世界状态表，将交互结果写回状态并渲染为粗条件视频，由视频生成器补全细节，实现开放世界可交互与持久状态的长时序视频世界模型。
result.reason: Interactive video world model with explicit persistent world state, agent-driven interaction planning, and long-horizon state-consistent video generation directly matches video world model goals.
